summary: UTStarcom Holdings Corp. filed a Form 6-K on August 14, 2026, reporting unaudited financial results for the first half of 2026. The filing includes a business update on Optical Circuit Switching development for AI data center networking, service renewals, and a 5G transport network shipment. Financial results show revenue of $3.4 million (down 26.1% year-over-year), a gross loss of $0.5 million, and a net loss of $5.1 million. Cash balance was $35.8 million. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or capital actions.
